Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 444 AM EST Tue Nov 3 2026

- Mild and breezy today with near record high temperatures and gusty 
winds up to 30 mph.    

- Mild conditions continue Wednesday with light rain likely.

&&

.AVIATION...

Drier air is working north out of Indiana early this morning 
demarcated by ceilings rising back to lower VFR in upstream obs. 
These ceiling improvements lift south to north over the first half of
the morning with the expectation all sites will be at or above 5kft 
by late morning. Breezy southwesterly winds develop during the 
daytime hours as gusts peak around 25kts with a few potentially 
closer to 30kts. VFR conditions hold for tonight before lower cloud 
and rain arrive Wednesday morning.

For DTW... Ceilings above 5kft have been observed over northern IN 
into far southern MI early this morning. Lower cloud quickly erodes 
in the first few hours of the new forecast period with VFR 
conditions maintained through tonight. MVFR to IFR cloud return 
Tuesday morning tied to the arrival of showers which will 
periodically cross the terminal for much of the day.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* High for ceilings 5000 ft or less early this morning low by late 
  morning-early afternoon.
